column1: # Settings for the optional well-level engine (src/models/hsm/us_onshore.py
# Used only when [hsm] onshore_engine_file names this file; otherwise C-HSM runs the reduced form.
# Set for C-HSM; see src/models/hsm/ENGINE_PLAN.md for the status and source of each value.
#   ramp_up_years         years a project takes to reach its full drilling rate
#   drill_predecline      share of a project's wells drilled before its drilling rate declines
#   low_price_flag        1 softens the drilling cut when prices fall below their base
#   discount_rate         real discount rate for the per-well cash flow test
#   rig_wells_cap_oil/gas most new oil-directed / gas-directed wells a year
#   rig_growth_rate       yearly growth of those caps (0: constant)
#   capex_deflator_1987_to_2023  scales the 1987 $ drilling cost regression to 2023 $
